labels: Shove your pretzel in his face!

nodes.text: Ten minutes later...
Kimi gets into Skazz's beat-up car wearing the slinky dress...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Whoa! You look like the girls on the magazines at the grocery store!
Kimi gets into Skazz's beat-up car wearing the cutout top and shorts...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Whoa! Your top has holes in it!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's supposed to.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Oh, cool. It's kinda hot.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks?
Skazz drives off.
A few minutes later, as Skazz is telling a story...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: So then, `I` tried to do a rail grind, and--
nodes.text_bbcode: So then, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] tried to do a rail grind, and--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --Wait... What are you wearing? Why do you have so much camouflage on? Why do you have `any` camouflage on?! Why are you not answering these questions?!
nodes.text_bbcode: --Wait... What are you wearing? Why do you have so much camouflage on? Why do you have [color=#3b78e2][i]any[/i][/color] camouflage on?! Why are you not answering these questions?!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Okay... I think there might have been a miscommunication on the phone.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Body Spray is a paintball arena.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! I have to change!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: There's no time for costume changes! We've got a match against some of the wrestling guys in five minutes!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't want to play paintball, and I definitely don't want to play paintball in one of my favorite outfits! Last I checked, paint stains!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Why didn't you say something when you saw my outfit?!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I thought you were just being risky.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, I wasn't!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What? Why are you smiling like that?
A little while later...
Kimi is hiding behind a wall inside the Body Spray arena. Skazz hands her a paintball gun.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: All right, look. We're up against Steve and Darren. All we have to do is take them out before they take out us!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We do that and the game's over?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yeah, unless you want to play again?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I just want to get out of here without any paint on me...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Then follow my lead. Let's go.
Kimi watches as Skazz begins to navigate deftly through the arena, his body crouched low and cat-like.
Periodically, he aims his paintball gun down a corridor, checking for Steve and Darren.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: If you see them, don't give away your position.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Got it.
After a minute or so, Kimi notices a rhythm to Skazz's movements...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Step, step, aim. Step, step, aim...

nodes.prompt: Make your choice! Step, step, aim!!

nodes.text: Kimi keeps up with Skazz's rhythm, following his lead...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Step, step, aim! Step, step, aim!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Good! You've got this!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I've totally got this!
Kimi tries to follow along with Skazz's movements, but she gets confused!
When Skazz stops at a corner, Kimi takes a step and trips over Skazz's feet!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Skazz hisses at her!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Why don't you make `more` noise?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Why don't you make [color=#e23b3b][i]more[/i][/color] noise?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry...
She gets up, dusts herself off, and resumes patrolling.
She aims her gun down another corridor...
...And sees Darren coming, his head turned away from her!
On the way home...
Kimi reaches over and jams her pretzel in Chris's face!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Hrrgggg!
The audience cheers, and the spotlight swivels to find another clown.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yes! It worked!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: But at what cost?!
Kimi turns to Chris, his face red from the force of the pretzel... And the embarrassment.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, Chris... I'm so--

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Save it. Let's just never talk about this again.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay. Whatever you want.
Kimi reaches over and pulls Chris in for an intense kiss!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Mmmmf!
The crowd goes wild, cheering louder than it had all night!
When Kimi lets Chris go, the spotlight swivels away!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, that was fun!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: My mouth... That was... Kiss.
Unsure of what to do, Kimi grabs her pretzel and shoves it in Chris's face!
Chris and Kimi talk for a while. Finally, the show begins!
First, trapeze artists somersault through the air, catching each other high above the ground!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whoa! They're so strong!
Then, a woman does a perfect dive into a tiny pool!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: And I'm afraid to dive off the high board at the community center!
Finally, a parade of elephants comes out to do tricks!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So cool! Look how big they are!
As the show is reaching its conclusion, the lights dim, and a bunch of spotlights shine on the crowd!
Each one finds a clown that had been sitting in the audience! And each clown does a funny gag before the spotlight moves on!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Oh no! Someone's going to think that I'm--
Before Chris can finish the thought, one of the spotlights swivels their way!
Chris is blinded as the audience waits in anticipation of his trick!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Uh...
The crowd starts booing!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Uh... Help!

options.label: Shove your pretzel in his face!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Thanks for the brutal honesty...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Chris. No one wants to hear that...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But it also seems like if no one told you, you'd go on living with this unhealthy attachment to Maria.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: So, what am I supposed to do? Just stop talking to her? Stop hanging around her? Stop thinking about her? Stop talking about her?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, actually. Start small. No more Maria talk.
Chris sighs.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: You're probably right. I'll stop talking about her, I promise.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: The last thing you want to do on a date is talk about some other girl.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It wasn't on my dream date list, no.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Heh. So... What do `you` like?
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. So... What do [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] like?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hee. Well...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: I do!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, there's nothing wrong with having feelings for someone!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: That's true... So I guess I'll just keep thinking about her and dreaming about her and following her around!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, well...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Thanks, Kimi! Great advice!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Can you do me one favor?

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: You want me to stop talking about her on our date?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, pretty much.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Can do!
Kimi and Chris find their seats.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: I'm going to go grab us some snacks. Want a jumbo pretzel?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks, but I'm not really into pretzels... Maybe some kettle corn?

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Oh. Sure...
Chris heads off toward the concession stand. A few moments later, he comes back with the food!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Here's your pretzel.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, uh...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Whoops. I forgot... You asked for kettle corn. It's Maria who likes jumbo pretzels...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No problem. But what's going on with you and Maria?

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Why do you ask? Does it seem like I'm obsessed? Because I'm not obsessed!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: She's only the most wonderful human being I ever met! And she smells like a flower that doesn't exist!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Right. Are you two... Dating?

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: It's complicated. Mostly I hang around her. But from time to time, when all is right with the world, she asks me to get things for her!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Do you think I'm pathetic?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: To be honest, Chris...

options.label: It does sound kind of pathetic!
It just sounds like you really like her!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I mean... You do kind of look... A little bit like a clown!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Heh. But you can only fit one of me in my car.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hee hee! And you make me laugh!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Come on, let's get our seats...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Is it? Because I always thought I do kind of look like a clown...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What? No way...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: They're not mistaking me for one just out of nowhere! It happens a lot for a reason.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, I guess you... Kind of look like one.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: I do?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You just said--

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: You're not supposed to agree with them! You're supposed to make me feel better! And handsome! And un-clown-like!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm sorry!

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Come on! Let's just get our seats!
Later that night, Skazz pulls up to Kimi's house...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You did better than I expected today.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks! I think...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Even though we won, I'm sorry you got paint on your clothes...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's okay... It's just one outfit. One outfit that I loved dearly...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: And...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I'm sorry we didn't end up dancing...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Actually, we kinda did.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Never mind. Anyway, I had a good time, Skazz.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: No more dates though, right?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I hope you understand that no, there won't be. We're just not a good match.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: That's cool. I kinda figured. Anyway, see you around or whatever.
He drives off.
The next school day...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, how'd it go with Skazz?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I had a surprisingly fun time with him...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But he's not Kimi material. I'm high fashion, he's grunge.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Let's not talk about it...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Got it.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So... Does anyone else have any future boyfriends for me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've got one! He's a nerd, and I think he'd like you. Plus, he's just coming out of a relationship.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are you talking about Kevin?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Of course not! That'd be weird of me! Heh.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm talking about Chris! He's a nerd, he might like you... And he's kind of getting over Maria.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: He dated Maria?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Date's a funny term.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yikes. I don't know...
Ryan walks by.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: 'Sup, hottie.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Never mind. Set it up.
That night, Chris and Kimi arrive at the circus! Kimi is wearing a sweater with some tight-fitting jeans.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks for giving me some advanced warning on where we were going, Chris. I actually got to wear something circus appropriate.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: You look nice...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: ...Maria used to wear something like that. She looked pretty, actually. But then again, she looks pretty in everything she wears.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uhhhhh... Maria. Right...
Inside the circus tent, Chris grabs Kimi by the arm.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: I should warn you, and it's no big deal, but sometimes I get mistaken for a clown.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! That's...
Kimi gets the shot off before Steve can react!
Paint splatters all over him!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Ick! Ick! Ick! Why am I even here?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yes! I got him in one shot!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: That was so awesome!
Kimi is too slow to fire!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh no!
Steve lowers his aim and shoots, hitting Kimi right in the neck!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hccck!
Paint splatters all over her clothes!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: NOOOOOOOOOO!
A split second later, Skazz manages to hit a distracted Steve!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yeah! We won!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yay...
A few moments later, while turning a corner, Skazz sees Steve! At the same time, Steve sees Skazz!
Both of them hide behind cover!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I've got you, man! You know I'm a better shot than you!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yeah, right! I always shoot better than you!
Kimi gets behind Skazz.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Is that true?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: No, Steve's a freakishly good shot.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So what do we do?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Well, Steve's got his scope aimed at chest height. If I popped around this corner...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: He wouldn't be expecting me to come from down low... But it would take too long to aim from that position.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So we need to get low fast?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Pretty much.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well... Why don't you dip me?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Uh, what?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Dip me down, and I'll swing my arm out and take the shot.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Do you really think that'll work?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I have no idea, but it's worth a shot.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Heh. Okay. How do I do that?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just hold me like this...
Kimi demonstrates, and Skazz holds her.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then, when you're ready, lunge.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Okay, on three! One, two, three!
He lunges down into a deep dip.
Kimi's head appears from behind the corner, but only a few feet off the ground. She can see Steve, but his attention is much higher.
In a fluid motion, she whips her paintball gun out! The movement grabs Steve's attention!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Oh! What the--
Kimi and Skazz simultaneously burst out from behind their cover!
An instant later, both of them are pointing their paintball guns at a surprised Darren.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Aww, man!
They pepper him with paintballs!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Gotcha!
Kimi hesitates as Skazz bursts out from behind the cover!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whoops!
Darren fires at Skazz, but misses high! Skazz's paintball connects with Darren's chest!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Skazz turns back to Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Thanks for the help!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I got nervous!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Come on, we still have to get Steve...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wait... Now?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: On my signal, we'll spin out in opposite directions and blast him!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Got it.
They can hear Darren's footsteps...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Not yet...
Getting closer...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Not yet...
Then the sound of Darren's pants shuffling together...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Now!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Darren comes to attention, aims his gun and fires... Just as Skazz tackles her, pulling her behind some cover!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You're supposed to be `quiet,` not stupidly loud!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're supposed to be [color=#e23b3b][i]quiet,[/i][/color] not stupidly loud!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm sorry, I just--
He cuts her off!
She quietly ducks behind cover!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't think Darren saw me!
She gets Skazz's attention...
A second later, Skazz scrambles across, joining her! He whispers to her...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm sorry, I just--
He cuts her off!
She stands there, motionless for second. Then...
Kimi slips past Brinna and steps into detention.
The rest of the Troublemakers are already there.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, Kimi. You're last in. That means you've got to tell us a secret about your day.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And it'd better be good! None of these raisin-based confessions lame-o's always giving us!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Raisins are my only vice.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Spill it, Chen.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I do notice you have a slightly downturned mouth... Perhaps something is wrong?
As Kimi answers, the door behind her opens...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, how about I'm never going to fall in love!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Nonsense! You can only come to that realization when you're like me! A mere, ahem, `thirty` years old and single!
nodes.text_bbcode: Nonsense! You can only come to that realization when you're like me! A mere, ahem, [color=#3b78e2][i]thirty[/i][/color] years old and single!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, Ms. Lee! Does this mean you're Principal `and` running Troublemakers?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, Ms. Lee! Does this mean you're Principal [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] running Troublemakers?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: A-plus as always, Spencer. The rest of you should consider this young man a role model, especially after everything he did to bring down Mr. Hart!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `He` did? But I was the Town Crier!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]He[/i][/color] did? But I was the Town Crier!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh, fine! An honorable mention for Aaron!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Who's Aaron? Wait... Am I Aaron?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Anyway! After Mr. Hart, we can't trust anyone else as your supervisor, so I'll be doing that. As an added bonus, I can run some of my new school principal ideas past you!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: What do you think of giving everyone a label displaying their GPA? That way you can all model yourselves after the best and brightest!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That sounds like a bad idea, Ms. Lee.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, really bad.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It could lead to a lot of problems...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: So we'll put that one in the Maybe pile.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh! Before you all get to studying... I should tell a certain lonely, desperate individual...
She looks right at Kimi...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: My nephew will be joining the program! He's single, the nicest, sweetest boy you'll ever know, and gorgeous!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I hope it's not weird that I said that...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: A little...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Great! Time to study, kids!
After detention...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay! That's it! I'm `not` going to be set up with Ms. Lee's nephew! That's where I draw the line!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay! That's it! I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] going to be set up with Ms. Lee's nephew! That's where I draw the line!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I `have` to be dating someone by the time he arrives, and that means...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to be dating someone by the time he arrives, and that means...

nodes.text: Kimi looks to the Troublemakers.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That means you have to set me up on dates! Please! There must be some single guys that you know...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Would you be interested in someone from the Wilson High wrestling team?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't know... I heard those Wilson guys have rabies and bathe in sludge water.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: They're not my favorite people. But that rabies thing's not true.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Notice he didn't say anything about the sludge water.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Because it's so ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But seriously, Kimi, the guy I'm thinking of might actually be an okay date.
Kimi takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay then. Set it up.
After school, Kimi's hanging out in her room when her phone rings. She answers...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hello, this is Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hey! This is Skazz! You ready for our exciting date?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey... Skazz. No, actually... I don't know anything about--

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Aw, man. I forgot to tell Owen to tell you what we're doing! It's going to be so sick!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's... Good, right?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Of course! It's at this place called Body Spray, so make sure you dress appropriately.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wait... What is Body Spray?
Skazz's voice starts cutting out...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: It's a... --Ance... Ball... So awesome!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I didn't hear that. We're going dancing? At a ball?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hey, Kimi! You're cutting out! But, I'm glad you approve. It is a good call!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I didn't say that! What kind of dance club is it?!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I'll pick you up in ten minutes, okay?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What?! Ten minutes?! I can't get ready for anything in ten minutes, let alone for something I don't know!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Cool. See you soon! Late.
Skazz hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ten minutes! Don't freak out! What to wear for a first date at a club?! This slinky blue dress `or` this cutout top with these blue shorts...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ten minutes! Don't freak out! What to wear for a first date at a club?! This slinky blue dress [color=#3b78e2][i]or[/i][/color] this cutout top with these blue shorts...

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Oh, really? Well, I'm super scared of your vague threat.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just get out of my way!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Ha! Bye, Pig Girl!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Is that a threat?!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, it's a threat, witch.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Oh, really? Well, I'm super scared of your vague threat.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just get out of my way!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Ha! Bye, Pig Girl!

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Someday real soon... You're going to learn how to speak?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No! Stuff. Will. Happen!
Down the hall, she sees Ben and Emily walking hand in hand.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: When did `everyone` become a couple? Ben and Emily...
nodes.text_bbcode: When did [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone[/i][/color] become a couple? Ben and Emily...

nodes.text: She turns the corner, the detention room just ahead...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Delilah and Erik, Paige and Owen, Spencer and Candace, $ALLISON and... Nate, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I know that life shouldn't revolve around relationships, but it feels like no one's ever REALLY liked me...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Other than, literally, a pig...
She sighs.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Dear Universe: Please hook me up with a boyfriend. He doesn't even have to be hot, just mildly cute. Sent from my desperate state, Kimi.
She's so distracted, her eyes downturned, she doesn't see who's blocking the door.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Hey, Pig Girl, daydreaming of your perfect hogfriend?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What is it, Brinna?

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! Those shoes are sooooo never in style. You must have made them, huh?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What `is` it, Brinna? I'm not in the mood, and I have to go to detention.
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] it, Brinna? I'm not in the mood, and I have to go to detention.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Nothing. Just gloating about my victory over you.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: I can't believe how easy it was to convince you that you had a secret admirer! Surely you knew no guy would ever fall for you. Or... Maybe not. I guess you know now.

nodes.speaker: Brinna
nodes.text: Bonus! The pic I took of you running in circles with a pair of hogs is the home screen for my phone, see?
She holds up the phone, a devilish grin on her face.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Enjoy it now, Brinna, because someday real soon...
Kimi walks right on by, ignoring them.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Did she even hear us?!
Nicole raises her voice.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I BET PIG GIRL'S GOING TO TAKE A BOY PIG TO THE DANCE!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: HA! YEAH! OINK OINK!
Mr. Dean angrily pops his head out of a nearby classroom.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Mr. Dean!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Why are you causing a ruckus right outside my door?!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What? We weren't, uh...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: None of you are getting good enough grades to be this loud!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Sorry, Mr. Dean...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Heh. Busted!
Kimi continues along...
Kimi stops and faces them.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, I've been looking at pigsties, Nicole! Like, your house!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I don't actually speak pig.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I do! Oink oink oink!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Hahaha! Go away, Pig Girl, you're making this whole area stink like pig slop!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What did I think was gonna happen? I should have just ignored them...
Kimi trudges away...
Some of the more popular students pop out of a class in front of Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Prom is coming! How have we not talked about this?! Who is everyone going with?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm not sure. I've been asked by SO many guys. I wish I could go with all of them.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What about you, Jacob?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I dunno. Not sure yet. Is it this week?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What?! It's in, like, two months!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Oh, then why are we talking about it now?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Shh! Shh! Shh! Look who's coming! It's Pig Girl!
The group giggles as Kimi passes by...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, Kimi, the dance is coming up... Scoping out pigsties for potential dates?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Ha! Yeah! Oink oink, Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Well, why don't you tell me how you really feel?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Maybe that's not the nicest thing, but it just seems foolish. I know I wouldn't have done it.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: And maybe that's what separates people like you from people like him!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I guess you're right...
Delilah storms off!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That probably could have gone better...
Kimi continues on her way to detention...

Delilah storms off!

Kimi continues on her way to detention...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It takes courage to stick your neck out like that.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I know! I thought I was lucky for finding someone smart, handsome, `and` funny. Little did I know I was dating a knight!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know! I thought I was lucky for finding someone smart, handsome, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] funny. Little did I know I was dating a knight!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi

nodes.text: Thanks, Kimi! See ya around!
Kimi says goodbye to Delilah and continues on her way toward detention...

nodes.speaker: Kimi

Delilah storms off!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That probably could have gone better...
Kimi continues on her way to detention...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Really... What?

nodes.speaker: Kimi

nodes.text: At school the next week, Kimi walks down the hall, again in her blue slip-on shoes...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, I went on three dates...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...And all of them were duds. I guess... I'm going to be alone forever.
Kevin approaches her.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Hey, Kimi?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Huh? Oh... Hey, Kevin.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm fine. Why?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: It's just... I've noticed you wearing a lot of blue lately...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: ...You always wear blue when you're sad.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I guess I am a little bit--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --Wait, who are you? And what have you done with Kevin?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Funny. I know, I know, I wasn't very observant when we were dating... But a guy can change.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You might also be surprised to learn that I've stopped playing video games.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: No, but I have cut back a lot.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hee. If that were true, I'd assume your body had been taken over by aliens.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Only in my dreams...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Anyway, that's not important. What's important is you're feeling sad... And I think I can cheer you up!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: It's a little game I like to play...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Does it involve taking my words and transforming them into a bad poem?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Because I think I've had enough of that.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uhhhh... No, it's more of a game where I make you laugh.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I like the sound of that.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Knock knock.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Really? This is where you're going? This is your bread and butter?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Just play along, would you?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Fine. Who's there?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: A little old lady...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: A little old lady who?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Why are you yodeling?

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: There's that smile I was looking for!

lines.speaker: Kimi
lines.text: Okay, fine, you got me!
Kimi and Kevin reach the door to detention.

lines.speaker: Kimi
lines.text: This is my stop. Thanks, Kevin. For cheering me up.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: Sure thing. And Kimi?

lines.speaker: Kimi
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: Try a different color tomorrow. Maybe something bright?

lines.speaker: Kimi
lines.text: I promise.
As Kevin walks off, Kimi can't help but reflect...

lines.speaker: Kimi
lines.text: Maybe Kevin `has` changed. Maybe I should give him another chance...
lines.text_bbcode: Maybe Kevin [color=#3b78e2][i]has[/i][/color] changed. Maybe I should give him another chance...

lines.text: She opens the door to detention...
...And almost runs into a tall guy she's never seen before, a guitar slung over his back.

lines.speaker: LOGAN
lines.text: Watch the goods, Clumsy.

lines.speaker: Kimi
lines.text: Maybe don't stand next to doors, whoever you are.

lines.speaker: Ms. Lee
lines.text: This is my nephew I was telling you about... Logan!

lines.speaker: LOGAN
lines.text: I'm in your dumb group now.

lines.speaker: Ms. Lee
lines.text: Isn't he sweet?

lines.speaker: Kimi
lines.text: Sweet? No. Hot? O.M.G. yes!

Kevin and Chris are playing Plague Era: Reloaded on Kevin's widescreen TV.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: Man, this village is swarming with rats!

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: No problem, I found a flamethrower on that last plague doctor.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: Sweet! Keep the rats off me while I check the symptoms of these townspeople.

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: You got it!

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: So, uh, how'd it go with Kimi? Did you guys have a good time at the circus?

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: Yeah, it was fun. We kind of agreed that we weren't a good match, though.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: Oh yeah? Why's that?

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: Well, I think she's just looking for something else...

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: And I'm looking for some`one` else...
lines.text_bbcode: And I'm looking for some[color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] else...

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: Still stuck on Maria, huh?

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: I'll probably be stuck on her for the rest of my life...

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: But enough about me. Got your eye on anyone?

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: Now that you mention it, I did have a promising conversation with this one girl today...

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: A conversation? Nice! Who with?

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: With Kimi, actually. I mean, I know things didn't end that well between us, but I think there's still something there.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: And, I don't know, when I talked to her today it felt like maybe there was a chance I could win her back.

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: That's awesome! We should plan something after this next boss fight...

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: If it's alright with you, I might have to duck out of this one.

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: What? The Feast of the Infested King is up next! That fight is almost impossible in singleplayer!

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: Let's tackle it tomorrow. I'm trying to cut down on my gaming time, at least a little bit.

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: Cut down on gaming? What? But... Why?

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: It's part of my plan to win Kimi back. We broke up because I spent too much time playing videogames and not enough time with her, so I'm trying to change that.

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: Okay, I guess you've got a point.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: I just hope it's worth it. Kimi spends so much time with the Troublemakers these days, it's almost impossible to get any alone time with her.

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: Why don't you just join Troublemakers?

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: It's not a club, Chris. It's basically detention every day of the week! You pretty much have to commit a crime to get in!

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: Like loitering?

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: Worse.

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: Hmm, I've got an idea...

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: Oh yeah? What is it?

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: Before Hector graduated, he taught me everything he knows about party planning. I promised to carry on his legacy here at Twin Branches...

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: And now's the perfect time to get started!

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: Well, yeah, that's awesome, but how is that going to help with my Kimi situation?

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: Ah, Kevin. You're obviously a party novice.

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: `Anything` can happen at a good party! Friends can become worst enemies, nerds can become cool, and exes can get back together!
lines.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Anything[/i][/color] can happen at a good party! Friends can become worst enemies, nerds can become cool, and exes can get back together!

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: `And` I'll get a chance to show off my rock collection! It's a win-win!
lines.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]And[/i][/color] I'll get a chance to show off my rock collection! It's a win-win!

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: Do you really think that would work?

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: Definitely! It'll take a few weeks to get everything ready, but I've got a good feeling about this.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: All right then... Set it up!

nodes.text: Kimi picks up a glass of water from a nearby table.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Excuse me, I have to borrow this.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Oh what? Now you're going to--
Kimi tosses the glass of water in Lee's face!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Phhhbbbbt!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And your poem stinks!
She marches off!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Fine! This I've gotta hear!
Lee takes a deep breath...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I had a girlfriend... After Paige.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: And we used to come here, and I'd recite poetry to her, just like I did with all of you.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: But then, she left me...
One of the other girls sits down.

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: Awww...
Followed by the other.

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: That's so sad.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I'm not saying that what I've been doing is right...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: But I guess I've just been trying to bring back those old memories... I've been trying to find her again.
Both girls put their hands over their hearts.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: To be honest, I didn't think I ever would... Until tonight... With you, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: With me? Really?
Kimi looks to the other girls, expecting them to throw more water in Lee's face...

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: You can't argue with this, sweetie. It must be love.

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: You're the one.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't know if I want to be the one... This all seems really weird.
As Lee takes Kimi's hands in his, and the other girls coo with approval, it occurs to Kimi that she's about to go down a path of distrust...
Of lies and unfaithfulness...
And there's no escape. She knows...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: And, like that first taste of BBQ chicken...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Look upon the rolling sea...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: The purple mountains...
Lee clears his throat, looking longingly at Kimi...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: And now a food!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Now give me a word that describes the sea...
Kimi and Lee sit down together at a fancy Italian restaurant...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm so glad you agreed to go on this date with me, Lee.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Are you kidding? A chance to share a romantic dinner with a cute girl like you... I'd be a fool to pass that up.
Kimi blushes.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So... How'd you pick this place?
Lee gazes into Kimi's eyes.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Honestly, I wanted to set the right mood. And when I thought about who you are... What I know about you...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: This place, with its luminous candlelit tables, soft Italian music, and beautiful Italian landscapes adorning the walls... All of it says, 'Kimi Chen'.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: After all, you are luminous, soft, and beautiful.
Kimi can barely breathe...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Water!
She takes a big drink from her glass.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Heh heh. I'm sorry if I'm coming on too strong... I'm just passionate about what I want.
A waiter comes by to take their order and fills up their glasses.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Hey! Want to play a game? It's a good way to get to know each other.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sure... What's the game?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I'll say something, and you say the first thing that pops into your head!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay! Sounds fun!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: All right...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Name a color...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: They long to be...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Close to that which is out of reach, like I to thee.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That was beautiful...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I was inspired.
Lee reaches out to take Kimi's hand. She gives it to him, and he kisses it delicately.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Best date ever! Am I really this into Lee?!
Suddenly, a girl comes storming up to their table!

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: You pig!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: How dare you call me pig?! You don't even know--
But before Kimi can finish, the girl snatches up Kimi's glass of water...
...And throws it in Lee's face!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Phbbbbbbbt!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What's going on?!

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: I'll tell you what's going on! You're on `our` date! Lee took me here two weeks ago!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll tell you what's going on! You're on [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] date! Lee took me here two weeks ago!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: Really! He's a creep!
The girl storms off. Kimi arches an eyebrow at Lee.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Look... I go on dates. I like this place. Is that so wrong?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I guess not... It's just you said this place was special to me...
Another girl comes storming up to their table!

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: I can't believe you!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What the--
With one quick motion she picks up Lee's glass and tosses it into his face!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Phhbbbt! I'm getting tired of this!

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: Well, maybe you should have thought of that before taking `her` out on the same date we had last week!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, maybe you should have thought of that before taking [color=#3b78e2][i]her[/i][/color] out on the same date we had last week!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wait... You went here with `another` girl?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... You went here with [color=#3b78e2][i]another[/i][/color] girl?

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: Yeah! And he told me this place was chosen especially for me. Because I'm luminous or whatever!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Really?!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: You can both be luminous!
Just then, `another` girl arrives!
nodes.text_bbcode: Just then, [b]another[/b] girl arrives!

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: I knew it! I knew you were two-timing me!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Oh, come on!
Kimi hands the girl a glass of water, which she tosses in Lee's face!

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: How dare you recite poetry from your father to me yesterday and then bring this girl here tonight!

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: Wait... Poetry... The mountains and the sea?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just out of reach, like I to thee...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Girls! Girls! Let me explain!
At school the next week, Kimi walks down the hall, again in her blue slip-on shoes...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, I went on three dates...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...And all of them were duds. I guess... I'm going to be alone forever.
Kevin approaches her.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Hey, Kimi?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Huh? Oh... Hey, Kevin.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm fine. Why?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: It's just... I've noticed you wearing a lot of blue lately...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: ...You always wear blue when you're sad.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I guess I am a little bit--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --Wait, who are you? And what have you done with Kevin?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Funny. I know, I know, I wasn't very observant when we were dating... But a guy can change.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You might also be surprised to learn that I've stopped playing video games.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: No, but I have cut back a lot.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hee. If that were true, I'd assume your body had been taken over by aliens.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Only in my dreams...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Anyway, that's not important. What's important is you're feeling sad... And I think I can cheer you up!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: It's a little game I like to play...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Does it involve taking my words and transforming them into a bad poem?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Because I think I've had enough of that.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uhhhh... No, it's more of a game where I make you laugh.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I like the sound of that.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Knock knock.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Really? This is where you're going? This is your bread and butter?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Just play along, would you?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Fine. Who's there?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: A little old lady...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: A little old lady who?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Why are you yodeling?
Kimi hands the girl a glass of water, which she tosses in Lee's face!

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: How dare you recite poetry from your father to me yesterday and then bring this girl here tonight!

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: Wait... Poetry... The mountains and the sea?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just out of reach, like I to thee...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Girls! Girls! Let me explain!
Kimi and Lee sit down together at a fancy Italian restaurant...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm so glad you agreed to go on this date with me, Lee.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Are you kidding? A chance to share a romantic dinner with a cute girl like you... I'd be a fool to pass that up.
Kimi blushes.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So... How'd you pick this place?
Lee gazes into Kimi's eyes.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Honestly, I wanted to set the right mood. And when I thought about who you are... What I know about you...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: This place, with its luminous candlelit tables, soft Italian music, and beautiful Italian landscapes adorning the walls... All of it says, 'Kimi Chen'.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: After all, you are luminous, soft, and beautiful.
Kimi can barely breathe...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Water!
She takes a big drink from her glass.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Heh heh. I'm sorry if I'm coming on too strong... I'm just passionate about what I want.
A waiter comes by to take their order and fills up their glasses.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Hey! Want to play a game? It's a good way to get to know each other.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sure... What's the game?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I'll say something, and you say the first thing that pops into your head!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay! Sounds fun!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: All right...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Name a color...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: I just want to say...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: Other than that moment that we are not talking about...

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: ...I'm sorry about all the clown stuff.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, don't worry. I mean it was kind of amusing, really.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: And I guess I'm also sorry about me obsessing over Maria.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, it just means you're not ready to date someone else yet. But you had to go out to realize that.

nodes.speaker: Chris
nodes.text: You're right. Thanks, Kimi.
The next day at school...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So? Shall I shout the name of Chrimi from the hilltops?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: 'Fraid not, Erik. I had fun, but it wasn't a love connection.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Bummer. Who are you going to go on a date with next?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm not sure... Getting set up's not working. There must be someone I haven't...
Just then, the swim team comes walking around the corner, and Kimi's eyes find Lee.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Bingo!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: If only Paige is okay with me dating her ex...
A few moments later...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Paige! I have to ask you something!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay, don't freak out! And please don't hate me! In fact, promise not to hate me!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What did you do?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Nothing, yet! Just promise!

Kevin and Chris are playing Plague Era: Reloaded on Kevin's widescreen TV.
Man, this village is swarming with rats!
No problem, I found a flamethrower on that last plague doctor.
Sweet! Keep the rats off me while I check the symptoms of these townspeople.
So, uh, how'd it go with Kimi? Did you guys have a good time at the circus?
Yeah, it was fun. We kind of agreed that we weren't a good match, though.
Well, I think she's just looking for something else...
And I'm looking for some`one` else...
I'll probably be stuck on her for the rest of my life...
But enough about me. Got your eye on anyone?
Now that you mention it, I did have a promising conversation with this one girl today...
With Kimi, actually. I mean, I know things didn't end that well between us, but I think there's still something there.
And, I don't know, when I talked to her today it felt like maybe there was a chance I could win her back.
That's awesome! We should plan something after this next boss fight...
If it's alright with you, I might have to duck out of this one.
What? The Feast of the Infested King is up next! That fight is almost impossible in singleplayer!
Let's tackle it tomorrow. I'm trying to cut down on my gaming time, at least a little bit.
Cut down on gaming? What? But... Why?
It's part of my plan to win Kimi back. We broke up because I spent too much time playing videogames and not enough time with her, so I'm trying to change that.
Okay, I guess you've got a point.
I just hope it's worth it. Kimi spends so much time with the Troublemakers these days, it's almost impossible to get any alone time with her.
Why don't you just join Troublemakers?
It's not a club, Chris. It's basically detention every day of the week! You pretty much have to commit a crime to get in!
Before Hector graduated, he taught me everything he knows about party planning. I promised to carry on his legacy here at Twin Branches...
And now's the perfect time to get started!
Well, yeah, that's awesome, but how is that going to help with my Kimi situation?
Ah, Kevin. You're obviously a party novice.
`Anything` can happen at a good party! Friends can become worst enemies, nerds can become cool, and exes can get back together!
`And` I'll get a chance to show off my rock collection! It's a win-win!
Do you really think that would work?
Definitely! It'll take a few weeks to get everything ready, but I've got a good feeling about this.
All right then... Set it up!
